newsitem.title: USA: Case gets $80 million Uzbekistan order.
newsitem.headline: Case gets $80 million Uzbekistan order.

text.p: Case Corp., an agricultural and constructiuon equipment maker, said Monday that Uzbekistan has bought about $80 million of its agricultural equipment.
The sale is the Racine, Wis.-based company's largest sale so far to the growing Central Asian agricultural equipment market.
The purchase, made by Uzbekistan's procurement and distribution agency, Uzselkhozsnabremont, includes 400 tractors, 200 combines and 400 model ploughs, it said.
Case also will supply product support, including training local technicians to service the equipment.
Case's stock fell 50 cents to $55.75 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
